Eli (Sales): Polaris wants a quick POC: embeddings (batch=8) followed by chat. Target: sustain 150-200 QPS chat, p50 < 120ms, short spikes up to 600 QPS. Need hosted vs dedicated cost delta and KMS/HSM latency numbers. Can we run a smoke tomorrow?

Rhea (PerfEng): Yep. Need model names and avg token sizes.

Eli (Sales): Models: chat-lite-v1 (~70 tokens) and embed-512 (~256 tokens each, batched 8). Embeds in hot path.

Marcus (SRE): Quick guidance: hosted should hit 150 QPS easily but bursts to 600 require burst pool or autoscale warmup. CMK (customer-managed key) adds ~8-15ms on our host shapes; HSM per-request would add more (~20-40ms). I'll quantify in the run.

June (Solutions): For costing: hosted unit ~= tokens*$0.0009 + misc; dedicated with commit can cut unit cost ~35-50%. I'll prepare a slide after perf numbers.

deploy-bot: perf-job-3923456789-hosted started by Marcus at 2026-03-22T07:05:12Z

Marcus (SRE): Ran a 10m hosted smoke at 180 RPS (mixed flow). Results: chat p50 118ms, p95 260ms, p99 420ms. Embedding batch p50 72ms. CMK test increased chat p50 by ~10ms. GPU ~70% util.

Rhea (PerfEng): Burst test (30s @ 600RPS) shows chat p50 210ms, p95 680ms, p99 1.2s. Tail improves with pre-warmed burst nodes.

Eli (Sales): Great — can you drop the log link and a one-line summary I can paste to procurement? They want KMS numbers in-line.

Marcus (SRE): Logs: https://internal.redwood/polaris/3923456789/logs.tar.gz. One-liner: "Hosted smoke: sustained 180RPS -> chat p50 118ms (CMK +10ms), embedding batch p50 72ms; 30s burst to 600RPS increases chat p99 to ~1.2s; recommend hosted for initial POC, Dedicated w/ burst pool for steady high-volume with lower unit cost."

June (Solutions): I'll convert to a cost table and include CMK/HSM latency deltas.

Eli (Sales): Thanks team — I'll send this to Polaris and ask if they require per-request HSM or just key custody+audit.
